question: A Ghatam is a ______.

options.text: small handheld drum that resembles a tambourine
percussion instrument made of leather and jackwood
large, narrow-mouthed earthenware pot used as a percussion instrument
wind instrument made of wood and metal

solution:
The correct answer is __**large, narrow-mouthed earthenware pot used as a percussion instrument**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Ghatam** is a **large, narrow-mouthed earthenware pot **used as a percussion instrument.
 
• The ghatam is a percussion instrument that is utilized in several Indian repertoires.
 
• The ghatam is an Indian percussion instrument that dates back thousands of years. It's a narrow-mouthed clay pot.
 
• A small amount of plasticine clay or water can be used to change the pitch significantly.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16ce91c8903f77f0a7d3059a0eca574979fc2791ef6b6e736d431834b45de744.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Kanjira** is a South Indian frame drum that belongs to the tambourine family of instruments. It has been used in India for generations as a folk and bhajan instrument.
 
• **Mridangam** is a leather and jackwood percussion instrument. This traditional instrument can be found throughout South India.
 
• **The saxophone** is a single-reed woodwind instrument with a conical, brass body. Sound is produced when a reed on a mouthpiece vibrates, producing a sound wave inside the instrument's body, as it is with all single-reed instruments.
